notes: The 'and' before 'smite' (t031) is added; תַּכֶּה is joined asyndetically in the Hebrew (rules 42, 30).
The assimilated articles before 'fire', 'sword' and 'wind' each take a written 'the' (rule 12); the two הַ on שְׁלִשִׁית are unrepresented because the ASV writes 'a third part' (rule 29).
'in the midst of the city' and 'the days of the siege' each write two 'the's, so the present article takes the one before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one (rule 29).
